about: What the deploy workflow ktl-website installs needs from GitHub. `ktl gh` reads this file; ktl-sidecar's repository-settings.md describes its fields.

settings.name: KNOWLEDGE_WEBSITE_ENABLED

requires.text: Pages builds its site from GitHub Actions
no other publisher of the Pages site

settings.why: true lets the deploy job publish the default branch's build to GitHub Pages.

settings.name: KNOWLEDGE_RUNNER
settings.why: The label of the runner every job runs on, ubuntu-latest unless set.

settings.name: github-pages
settings.why: The deploy job runs in it on the default branch alone. GitHub creates it so when Pages takes its site from Actions.
